comment: Population strata and their needs (GDD 5.1; CORE simplified: three strata at the start, later eras add more). gathers: the stratum works the land (only producers in eras 1-2). fights (optional): the stratum widens the influence zone (GDD 5.4). targetShare: share of the population this stratum drifts towards, in percent; the shares must add up to 100. needs: amounts per person per year. 'category' means any good of that storage class (food = any food, eaten most perishable first); 'good' means one good. basic needs decide hunger and health, higher needs raise mood. crafts (optional, stage 3e): the stratum works the settlement's recipe.
